_comment: NSE trading holidays. MAINTENANCE MATTERS: a date wrongly listed here silences outage alerting for that whole day, while a missing date only causes a few capped false pages — so only add dates from the official NSE trading-holiday circular (nseindia.com > Resources > Trading holidays). The shipped list contains only certain fixed-date holidays; add the lunar-calendar ones (Holi, Ganesh Chaturthi, Dussehra, Diwali/Muhurat, Guru Nanak Jayanti, Id, Mahashivratri, Ram Navami, Good Friday...) for each year from the circular. scripts/oi-doctor.sh warns when this file looks under-maintained.
